title: Legacy setup.py package with a C extension
expected: Recognize legacy setuptools without evaluating arbitrary metadata on the host.
Declare Python headers and the C compiler before isolated execution; package the platform-specific extension.

cases.name: missing-compiler
cases.change: Execute on a worker without the declared C toolchain.
cases.expect: Capability/preflight failure, no fallback to a random host compiler.

limitations: Native smoke tests cover the Python reference function only. Compiled extension verification requires a C toolchain and tests/native_check.py after building.
Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
